home.reviewsSample: Sample reviews — shown for demonstration. Real customer reviews are not collected yet.

reviews.r1Text: The Hyderabadi mutton biryani was rich and fragrant — exactly how I remember it from home.
reviews.r2Text: Ordered ahead, walked in and it was ready. The mirchi salan is a must with any biryani.
reviews.r3Text: Great vegetarian options. The paneer tikka biryani had a lovely smoky flavour.

story.title: Where hunger meets flavours.
story.intro: ZAYORA began with a simple belief: a great biryani is worth waiting for — but you shouldn't have to wait in line for it.
story.dumText: Every biryani is layered by hand — marinated meat or vegetables, long-grain basmati, saffron, mint and fried onions — then sealed in a handi and slow-cooked in its own steam until every grain carries the flavour.
story.spicesText: Our masalas are blended in small batches from whole spices, so each dish tastes the way it should: warm, layered and never one-note.
story.freshText: From the tandoor to the dessert counter, dishes are prepared through the day and packed hot for pickup.
story.promiseText: Honest prices confirmed live from our kitchen, clear vegetarian and non-vegetarian labels, and an order that's ready when you are.
story.note: ZAYORA is a portfolio project that demonstrates a full-stack ordering system.
